name: To New Beginnings and Second Chances
source:
To New Beginnings and Second Chances is a short visual novel following a high school girl, Eva, as she learns to overcome her anxiety and find love.

[From [url=https://roseyang.itch.io/to-new-beginnings-and-second-chances]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《新的开始和第二次机会》是一部简短的视觉小说，讲述了高中女孩伊娃学会克服焦虑并寻找爱情的故事。

[来自[url=https://roseyang.itch.io/to-new-beginnings-and-second-chances]Itch.io[/url]]
